outcome: A plan is now refused unless it carries all nine sections the planner prompt mandates, checked with the shared parser instead of a substring that a fenced example could satisfy. A decomposition is bound to the plan it was built from: the recorder stamps project, story, epic, plan_file and the plan digest from trusted state and drops whatever an agent claimed, and stage start refuses when that plan has changed since — or when the binding cannot be verified at all. And build_waves stops being authored anywhere: prompts, the Codex agent contract, the doc and the scaffold check all let go of it together with its only reader, so ordering is derived from dependencies rather than written twice.
